sentences.text: Benjamin Geza Affleck-Boldt -LRB- born August 15 , 1972 -RRB- is an American actor and filmmaker .

His accolades include two Academy Awards , three Golden Globe Awards , two BAFTA Awards and two Screen Actors Guild Awards .	accolades	List of awards and nominations received by Ben Affleck	Academy Awards	Academy Awards	Golden Globe Awards	Golden Globe Awards	BAFTA Awards	BAFTA Awards	Screen Actors Guild Awards	Screen Actors Guild Awards	Golden Globe	Golden Globe Award for Best Motion Picture – Drama	BAFTA	BAFTA Award for Best Film

He later appeared in the independent coming-of-age comedy Dazed and Confused -LRB- 1993 -RRB- and various Kevin Smith films including Chasing Amy -LRB- 1997 -RRB- and Dogma -LRB- 1999 -RRB- .
